paper_title: Before Generation, Align it! A Novel and Effective Strategy for   Mitigating Hallucinations in Text-to-SQL Generation
caption: Results of different logical synthesis modules on BIRD-dev.

annotations.annotation: The bar chart illustrates and compares the execution accuracy of two different systems, NatSQL and TA-SQL, across three complexity levels of a task: Simple, Moderate, and Challenging, along with a Total category. The horizontal axis categorizes the task complexity, labeled as Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total in that order. The vertical axis represents execution accuracy, labeled as "Execution Accuracy", with a scale ranging from 20 to 60, marked in 10-unit intervals, indicating a linear scale. Each category contains two bars, one for NatSQL depicted in light blue and one for TA-SQL in dark blue with white space in between bars. In the Simple category, NatSQL has an approximate value of 60.21, while TA-SQL is at 63.14. For the Moderate complexity, NatSQL is at 39.64, and TA-SQL is at 48.60. In the Challenging category, NatSQL shows 32.32, and TA-SQL has a value of 36.11. The Total category shows NatSQL at 51.35 and TA-SQL at 56.19. The chart sorts the categories in no apparent order beyond logical grouping by complexity and totals, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color-coded distinction by system. A legend is given at top.
